display.name: Noob Resonator
display.tagline: A modal and waveguide resonator whose mode budget is spent by contribution rather than by frequency.
features: Ten objects: beams, bars, strings, tines, membranes, plates and air columns
Which modes you keep, not how many: 68 dB between the best and worst ordering at one cost
Six voices per object, so a chord of beams or a chord of pipes
Play chords into it over MIDI, with six memory slots
Every partial editable by hand, or drawn across in one stroke
33 presets in seven pairs, each pair one control apart
